Ishaan P: Quick report: trying the new Next + LlamaIndex starter from examples (fresh clone) and running into an auth/retry loop that blocks the sample onboarding. Browser shows spinner, server log shows repeated 401 then 502 and endless retries.
Rina K: repro steps? node / next / how are you setting the key?
Ishaan P: Node 20, Next 14.3, followed README: devcontainer up, paste ephemeral key into .env.local as REDWOOD_API_KEY, npm run dev, open /starter. Submit prompt -> spinner.
Evan T: can you paste the minimal log snippet?
Ishaan P: ```[2026-05-07T11:04:09Z] INFO ephemeral refresh invoked
[2026-05-07T11:04:09Z] ERROR request failed: 401 Unauthorized
[2026-05-07T11:04:09Z] INFO retrying request attempt=2
[2026-05-07T11:04:09Z] ERROR upstream 502 Bad Gateway
[2026-05-07T11:04:09Z] INFO retrying request attempt=3```
Rina K: Likely same parity gap we've seen: TS SDK refreshes token but in-flight requests still get 401 and the retryer keeps looping because it doesn't observe the refreshed token. Python client short-circuits retries after refresh.
Evan T: I repro. Quick local hack: after successful refresh set `client._lastRefresh = Date.now()` and make `shouldRetry` treat 401 as non-retryable if within 1500ms of `_lastRefresh`. Stops the infinite loop.
Ishaan P: Nice. Two DX asks: 1) README should explicitly say ephemeral tokens are short-lived and instruct to paste right before running devcontainer; 2) include a temporary env workaround for users: `export RW_ALLOW_SHORT_RETRY_FIX=1` so examples don't block.
Docs Bot: Please open PR for README change and add an onboarding note with expected server log snippet and common failure pattern. Also file follow-up issue for streaming cancel in the sample (Ishaan noticed sockets leak when navigating quickly).
Rina K: filing PR with the tiny retry guard and unit test. Will link docs PR after.
Evan T: I'll add an e2e that runs the starter in CI with ephemeral-key-mock to catch regressions.
Ishaan P: Thanks. Marking bootcamp sample blocked until SDK patch merges; we can ship examples with README note + workaround in the meantime.
Rina K: Ping here when tests/PR are green and docs PR is merged. :thumbsup:
